title: THE JUNCTION
now: Tuning the aisle from your first plays: which games you pick, where it feels slow, what’s hard to find.
Keeping every game free and one click away. No coins, no sign-up.

items.t: The arcade opens on our games, with larger card art on the tube. Pick one to visit its public game or development page; all 26 cabinets are still a shelf away.
The hints at the bottom follow whatever you play with: keyboard keys, gamepad buttons, or taps on a phone.
The aisle and the cabinet wall both have a button back to the Studio.
Grid view now fits and works on a phone.

releases.title: A warmer room, and no coins

items.t: Driving cabinets with wheels, motocross bars, a sit-down cockpit, and three styles of kick panel.
Every screen opens on its game’s most colourful demo moment, a little brighter than before.
Warmer light across the brick and the floor.
No INSERT COIN anywhere. Every game plays the moment you pick it.
One game a day on the Studio’s home page, with its own high-score table. The button plays today’s round.

releases.title: THE JUNCTION opens
releases.summary: The arcade from THE PATH, open to everyone: 26 games, free, one click.

items.t: A row of real 3D cabinets, each running its own demo on the screen. Slide along with the arrow keys, a drag or the mouse wheel, and switch shelves with up and down: Classics, New Arrivals and Indie Gems.
Press Enter or click the cabinet in front of you and the view glides in until the game fills the screen. Escape steps you back.
Set them at the top under PLAYER and they go on the high-score tables.
GRID VIEW shows every cabinet at once.
Swipe the aisle, tap to play, and a touch stick and buttons come up while you play.
